style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Bring festive magic into even the coziest spaces with the 1.5m Pre-Lit Slim Ridgemere Pine Christmas Tree. Perfectly designed for apartments, hallways, or snug corners, this beautifully crafted tree offers the charm of a full Christmas centerpiece without taking up too much room. Pre-Lit with Warm White LEDs – no tangled light strings! This tree comes pre-fitted with glowing warm white LED lights for instant holiday ambiance. Realistic Look – crafted from high-quality virgin PVC, with 332 hinged branch tips for a full, natural appearance and easy shaping. Slim Profile Design – ideal for small spaces where a traditional wide-base tree won’t fit.
